name: cybelinx-platform
description: Cybelinx Central SaaS Platform - control plane for tenant, identity, RBAC, entitlement, resource, provisioning and event plumbing

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @cybelinx/shared && npm run build --workspace @cybelinx/sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev:api: cmd /c "cd /d backend && mvnw.cmd -f pom.xml -pl central-api -am spring-boot:run"
scripts.dev:worker: cmd /c "cd /d backend && mvnw.cmd -f pom.xml -pl event-worker -am spring-boot:run"
